items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Oh my gosh those are phenomenal concept records. You put on “Wee Small Hours,” any of those albums, you drop a needle and go all the way through and it’s a story.

ctx.x: Billy May. Oh my gosh those are phenomenal concept records. You put on “Wee Small Hours,” any of those albums, you drop a needle and go all the way through and it’s a story. It’s a novel.

It’s very interesting, the fact that a lot of the sidemen, the swing musicians, after the big band era petered out, that they could walk into those studios and work. They were skilled enough to make that happen.
